_doc: Wicker fish traps (eel and fish baskets) the player sets in the edge water by a bank on the street map and comes back to (systems/fishTraps.js; on the map ui/innerMapFishTraps.js, drawn by ui/innerMapLayers/fishTraps.js). The good is 'fish_trap' (woven from reeds or willow withies at a craft bench, or bought from a chandler's stall with the nets, or wherever the market has them: data/playerEconomy.json, data/markets.json, data/crafting.json). Set one in shallows or in the water at most `bankReach` cells from dry land or the shallows; never on land, ice, a ford, a bridge or a pier; no nearer than `spacing` cells to another of yours; `perHex` to a map and `maxTraps` in all. Each hour in the water a trap takes a fish with chance `perHour[water]` x the hour (`hours`: dawn and dusk are the feeding times) x the season (`seasons`; nothing at all while its water is frozen over: world/streetSeasons.js) x `current` in a river (the fish run along the bank and into the mouth) x `baitMult` while baited. Bait (`baits`: bread, meat, cheese, a small fry...) is one from the packs and lasts `baitHours`. A trap holds `cap` catches; full, it takes no more. The species are the divers' of that water (data/diving.json fish.species, by weight), landed as the goods in `speciesItem`; `crayfish` is the share of catches that are crayfish instead (fresh water). Wear: `wearPerDay` a day; at 1 it has fallen apart and takes nothing till mended (`mendCost`). Losses, rolled once a day (night-time for poachers) on hashes of the world seed, the trap and the day: `poach` (only a trap with fish in it; townMult when a town stands on or beside the hex; x (1 + days unchecked / ageDays)): the catch goes to the thief, sold on in the nearest town's market (a named townsman of it when the town keeps a roster); now and then the trap too (`takeTrap`). On the map at night you may see the poacher at it: get within `scareReach` cells while he is there and he runs, the fish left. `otter`: an otter at the catch (rivers and lakes, wild water: townMult near a town), eating `otterEats` of it and tearing the wicker (`otterWear`). `flood`: a river in flood (systems/riverLife.js) washes a trap away with chance flood x the flood's severity. `catchUpDays`: hours caught up at most when time passes at a stroke. `reach`: cells from the trap you must stand to bait, haul or take it up.
